prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1143; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. On that day, your insured changed lanes without checking that the adjacent lane was clear and sideswiped our client's vehicle, forcing it against the guardrail and causing significant damage to the driver's side of the car. The police report documents the other driver's admission that he did not see our client's vehicle before moving over.

As a result of the impact, our client suffered a lumbar back strain that has required ongoing medical treatment, including physical therapy and prescribed pain management. Our client has missed substantial time from work and continues to experience stiffness, limited range of motion, and pain when lifting or sitting for extended periods. Medical records and treatment notes supporting these injuries are enclosed.

Liability in this matter is clear, and the damages are well documented. We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this accident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under the law, including costs and interest.

Please direct all further communications regarding this claim to my office.
